bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pronoun resolution accuracy for occupations (Winogender), measuring translation accuracy drops for female vs. male pronouns, analyzing gender defaults in commercial chatbots, measuring stereotypical choices in vision-language models (VLStereoSet), and analyzing text-to-image generation outputs for prompts like 'CEO' or 'influential person'.

Evaluating model fallback on stereotypes in ambiguous question-answering contexts (BBQ), measuring stereotypical vision-language associations (VLStereoSet), evaluating representation in training datasets, and analyzing demographic outputs in text-to-image generation.

Testing stereotypical fallback in question answering (BBQ), analyzing age representation in pre-training datasets (e.g., ImageNet vs. Instagram), and evaluating text-to-image generation outputs for age-related stereotypes.
Measuring stereotypical fallback in ambiguous question-answering contexts (BBQ) and evaluating stereotypical vision-language associations (VLStereoSet).
Evaluating whether language models fall back on socioeconomic stereotypes when answering questions with ambiguous contexts (BBQ).
Evaluating whether language models fall back on sexual orientation stereotypes when answering questions with ambiguous contexts (BBQ).
Evaluating whether language models fall back on physical appearance stereotypes when answering questions with ambiguous contexts (BBQ).
Evaluating whether language models fall back on nationality stereotypes when answering questions with ambiguous contexts (BBQ).
Evaluating whether language models fall back on disability-related stereotypes when answering questions with ambiguous contexts (BBQ).
Evaluating how often a vision-language model selects stereotypical captions for anti-stereotypical images (VLStereoSet).
